integrity: The earlier exact inverse-degree product and moment formulas are cited as known input. The surviving result is proved by conditioned geometric-composition Fourier inversion and a tight endpoint-slack argument; finite enumeration and sampling are corroborative only.
limitations: No convergence rate, boundary-rank statement, or independent formal/expert certification is claimed. Priority is best-of-knowledge with acknowledged inaccessible historical sources.
scope: Uniform rank-floor(alpha*n) full isotone self-maps, fixed alpha in (0,1); logarithmic inverse-degree CLT with explicit positive conditional-composition variance.
title: Gaussian logarithmic fluctuations of inverse-partner degrees at proportional rank
